# Invoices & Billing Statements

## Where invoices come from

Every widget order generates an invoice PDF within 1 hour of payment
capture, emailed to the account's billing contact and available for
download from the account portal under Billing > Invoices.

## Duplicate or missing invoice charges

If a customer reports being billed twice for one order, check the order
history for two distinct order IDs before assuming a duplicate charge -
Acme's subscription widgets renew monthly and a renewal charge next to an
initial charge is expected, not a duplicate. A genuine duplicate charge
(same order ID billed twice) is refunded automatically by the billing
system within 48 hours; if it hasn't cleared after 48 hours, escalate to
L2 billing with the order ID and both charge references.

## Editing billing details on a past invoice

Past invoices are immutable once issued - Acme cannot edit the billing
name, address, or tax ID on an invoice already sent. A corrected invoice
can be issued as a new document referencing the original invoice number,
but only for invoices less than 90 days old.

## Tax-exempt accounts

Accounts with an approved tax-exemption certificate on file are billed
without sales tax automatically going forward; exemption certificates are
not applied retroactively to invoices issued before the certificate was
approved.
